# QS-CFW-1476-90 - Quality specification - connecting rod CFW-1476-90 (1045)
Revision: Rev F  
Supersedes: Rev E  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-1476-90

Scope
This specification defines quality acceptance criteria and inspection methods for connecting rod CFW-1476-90 (CFW-1476-90) manufactured from 1045 material at Plant P3. It applies to forged, heat-treated, machined, and finished connecting rods prior to shipping.

Requirements table
| Feature | Specification |
|---|---|
| Material | 1045 (as specified on part drawing CFW-1476-90) |
| Hardness | 35-39 HRC |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.02 mm |
| Maximum forging weight | 41.6 kg |
| Visual | Free of forging laps, cracks, and flow defects that affect function |

Inspection method
- Hardness: Verify hardness on the bearing boss using a calibrated Rockwell tester at finished condition. Record readings and ensure values fall within 35-39 HRC.
- Dimensional: Measure rod bore(s) with calibrated bore gauge or coordinate inspection equipment. Verify bore diameter against drawing and tolerance ±0.02 mm. Record measured values on the inspection record.
- Weight: Confirm forging weight does not exceed the maximum forging weight 41.6 kg by weighing the forging prior to machining when required by process control. Record as part of batch documentation.
- Visual and surface: Perform visual inspection under adequate lighting to detect surface discontinuities that could compromise fatigue life. Tag parts that show unacceptable defects.

Nonconformance handling
- Parts failing hardness, dimensional, or visual acceptance criteria are segregated and tagged as nonconforming. Initiate corrective action per plant procedures and quarantine parts pending disposition.
- Disposition options include rework, repair, or scrap. Rework and repair must restore the part to full compliance with this specification and be approved by Quality Engineering.
- For any lot with systematic failures, perform root cause analysis and implement containment actions. Document findings and corrective actions in the quality record for the affected lot.
